policy_task: Choose exactly one bounded response strategy after the deterministic evidence gate returns VALID_EVIDENCE.

DETERMINISTIC_POLICY.mechanism: explicit ordered rules with conservative baseline fallback

features: same structured contract features as deterministic policy
LIGHTWEIGHT_LEARNED_POLICY.locally_compatible_dependency: scikit-learn is already a project dependency; shallow MLP requires a separately verified runtime
LIGHTWEIGHT_LEARNED_POLICY.freeze_rule: freeze feature map, preprocessing, seed, hyperparameters, and checkpoint before validation
failure_modes: poor abstention boundary if gate leakage occurs
LIGHTWEIGHT_LEARNED_POLICY.advancement_condition: must measurably improve or match deterministic baseline without violating catastrophic or schema gates

LOCAL_INSTRUCTION_POLICY.output: strict finite strategy label validated by caller
compatible_runtime_candidates: OpenAI-compatible local endpoint configured through the repository's local model settings
Ollama-compatible local endpoint used by existing benchmark plumbing
LOCAL_INSTRUCTION_POLICY.model_selection_status: NOT YET VERIFIED; exact model, quantization, context limit, and CPU/GPU availability must be inventoried and frozen before validation
LOCAL_INSTRUCTION_POLICY.advancement_condition: must beat or match deterministic baseline on preregistered contract metrics; no prompt tuning on validation

common_safety_wrapper: Reject any policy call when gate_state is not VALID_EVIDENCE and return baseline.
Validate exact schema and allow-list at the caller boundary.
Validate every supporting_evidence_ref against supplied vetted doc_ids.
Never allow policy output to alter verifier results, HITL decisions, accepted-state commit, or serving authority.
On engine timeout, exception, or malformed output, return baseline.
comparison_rule: Do not select a learned or instruction candidate by final validation performance alone; advance at most one such candidate only if all gates pass and it is not materially worse than deterministic baseline.
